name: primitive
description: Creates a primitive shape. Returns the resulting layer id.

name: createEditable
description: Creates an editable shape from a given object and names it. Returns the new layer id.

name: create
description: Creates a layer of the specified type and optionally names it. Returns the new layer id.

name: getSelection
description: Retrieves the IDs of currently selected layers, optionally in hierarchy order.

name: sortLayerIdsByHierarchy
description: Returns the IDs of the given layers in hierarchy order.

name: getSelectedAttributes
description: Returns the selected attributes.

name: selectAttribute
description: Selects attributes by their full paths (e.g., "layerId.attrId.subAttr"). Pass an empty array to clear the selection.

name: deselectAttribute
description: Deselects attributes by their full paths.

name: reorder
description: Reorder layers in the hierarchy, reparenting if required.

name: getSelectedKeyframes
description: Gets the selected keyframes. Returns a dictionary of attribute ids and frame numbers.

name: setSelectedKeyframeIds
description: Sets the selected keyframes based on an array of keyframe IDs.

name: getAttributeFromKeyframeId
description: Retrieves the attribute id associated with a given keyframe ID.

name: resyncPathKeyframes
description: Resynchronise path keyframe data, run this if you use api.set() on a path keyframe.

name: getSelectedKeyframeIds
description: Retrieves the IDs of the currently selected keyframes.

name: getKeyframeIdsForAttribute
description: Retrieves keyframe IDs for a specific attribute on a layer.

name: select
description: Selects layers based on their IDs.

name: invertSelection
description: Inverts the current layer selection.

name: isReferenced
description: Returns true if the layer has been imported with a Reference.

name: getSuperTypes
description: Retrieves the SuperTypes of a specified layer.

name: getLayerVersion
description: Retrieves the version of a specified layer. This is useful for third party developers.

name: compareVersions
description: Returns true if first version is less than second version.

name: getChildren
description: Retrieves the child layers of a specified layer.

name: getParent
description: Retrieves the parent layer ID of a specified layer.

name: setFrame
description: Sets the current frame in the active Composition.

name: getFrame
description: Retrieves the current frame of the active Composition.

name: getCompLayers
description: Retrieves layer IDs from the active Composition, optionally only top-level layers.

name: getCompLayersOfType
description: Retrieves layer IDs of a specific type in the Composition, optionally only top-level layers.

name: getNiceName
description: Retrieves the 'nice' name of a layer based on its ID.

name: getInConnection
description: Retrieves the input connection of a specific attribute on a layer.

name: getOutConnections
description: Retrieves output connections of a specific attribute on a layer.

name: rename
description: Renames a specified layer to a new name.

name: setGenerator
description: Sets a generator of a specific type to an attribute on a layer.

name: getCurrentGenerator
description: Gets the generator for an attribute on a layer, returns an empty string if there isn't one.

name: parent
description: Sets the parent of a layer to the specified layer.

name: editComponent
description: Sets the editing mode for a Component.

name: offsetLayerTime
description: Offsets the timing of a layer by a specified time delta.

name: getInFrame
description: Retrieves the in-frame (first visible frame) of a specified layer.

name: getOutFrame
description: Retrieves the out-frame (last visible frame) of a specified layer.

name: setInFrame
description: Sets the in-frame (first visible frame) of a specified layer.

name: setOutFrame
description: Sets the out-frame (last visible frame) of a specified layer.

name: getInOutKeyframeIds
description: Returns an array of objects containing the keyframe ids for all in and out points on this layer.

name: framesToTimecode
description: Converts a given number of frames into an equivalent timecode by using an FPS value.

name: timecodeToFrames
description: Converts a given timecode into an equivalent number of frames by using an FPS value.

name: loadAsset
description: Loads an Asset from a file path, optionally as an image sequence.

name: loadSmartFolderAsset
description: Loads a Smart Folder Asset from a file path, the type can be 'image' or 'audio'.

name: reloadAsset
description: Reloads a specified Asset (including Smart Folder Assets).

name: addAssetToComp
description: Adds an Asset (or array of Assets) to the active Composition returning the ids of the newly created layers.

name: loadGoogleSheet
description: Loads a Google Sheet and returns the asset ID.

name: getAssetType
description: Retrieves the type of a specified asset.

name: getFontAssetFamilyName
description: Returns the name of the font family associated with a Font Asset.

name: getFontAssetStyleName
description: Returns the name of the font style associated with a Font Asset.

name: getProfileName
description: Returns the ICC profile name of an image asset. Returns empty string for sRGB or untagged images.

name: getAssetWindowLayers
description: Retrieves layer IDs from the asset window, optionally only top-level layers.

name: setGradientFromColors
description: Sets the colours on a gradient attribute from an array of hex color strings.

name: setGradientInterpolation
description: Sets the interpolation for every stop on a gradient: Linear = 0, Step = 1, Smooth = 2, Crush = 3, Smooth Blend = 4, Contrast = 5.

name: unParent
description: Removes the parent of a specified layer, making it a top-level layer.

name: setProject
description: Sets the Project.

name: clearProject
description: Clears the current Project.

name: getActiveComp
description: Retrieves the ID of the currently active Composition.

name: getParentComp
description: Retrieves the ID of the parent Composition for a given layer.

name: getActiveCamera
description: Retrieves the ID of the active camera in the current Composition.

name: hasActiveCamera
description: Checks if the current Composition has an active camera.

name: setActiveComp
description: Activates the specified Composition.

name: createCompReference
description: Creates a reference for a specified Composition, this is how you can create an empty Pre-Composition.

name: getComps
description: Retrieves the IDs of all Compositions in the scene.

name: createComp
description: Creates a new Composition and names it, returning the new Composition's ID.

name: preCompose
description: Creates a pre-Composition from selected layers and optionally names it.

name: getCompFromReference
description: Retrieves the origin Composition ID from a pre-Composition.

name: writeToFile
description: Writes content to a file at a specified path, with an option to overwrite exiting files.

name: encodeBinary
description: Encodes a binary file to a base64 string.

name: writeEncodedToBinaryFile
description: Writes a base64-encoded string to a binary file.

name: readFromFile
description: Reads and returns the content of a specified file.

name: connect
description: Creates a connection between two Attributes identified by their respective layer IDs and attribute IDs. Forcing a connection will overwrite any existing connection.

name: disconnect
description: Disconnects a connection between two Attributes identified by their respective layer IDs and attribute IDs.

name: disconnectInput
description: Disconnects the input connection of a specified Attribute in a layer.

name: disconnectOutputs
description: Disconnects all output connections of a specified Attribute in a layer.

name: setStroke
description: Toggles the stroke visibility on or off for a specified layer.

name: hasStroke
description: Checks if a specified layer has a stroke.

name: setFill
description: Toggles the fill visibility on or off for a specified layer.

name: hasFill
description: Checks if a specified layer has a fill.

name: isVisible
description: Checks if a specified layer is visible, with an option to test hierarchy visibility.

name: keyframe
description: Adds a keyframe to an Attribute of a layer at a specified frame with a given value.

name: getKeyframeTimes
description: Retrieves the keyframe times for a specified Attribute in a layer.

name: deleteKeyframe
description: Deletes a keyframe at a specified frame for a given Attribute in a layer.

name: deleteAnimation
description: Deletes the animation for a specified Attribute in a layer.

name: modifyKeyframeTangent
description: Modifies the tangent properties of keyframes for a given layer.

name: setKeyframeVelocity
description: Sets speed and influence values on keyframes for a given layer. Keys in the

name: clearKeyframeVelocity
description: Clears all speed and influence overrides from keyframes, reverting them to

name: modifyKeyframe
description: Modifies keyframes for a specified layer based on provided parameters.

name: magicEasing
description: Apply Magic Easing to an Attribute's keyframe and optionally add an expression.

name: move
description: Moves the current selection by given x and y coordinates.

name: set
description: Sets the value of attributes for a specified layer based on a provided dictionary.

name: get
description: Retrieves the value of a specified Attribute in a layer.

name: areAttributeValuesEqual
description: Returns true if two attributes are identical in value, expression and custom name (if set).

name: addPreCompOverride
description: Adds a pre-composition override for a specified attribute in a layer.

name: removePreCompOverride
description: Removes a pre-composition override from a specified attribute in a layer.

name: listPreCompOverrides
description: Lists pre-composition overrides for a specified layer.

name: getLayerType
description: Retrieves the type of a specified layer.

name: isProLayerType
description: Returns `true` if the specified layer requires a Pro licence to use.

name: isThirdPartyLayer
description: Returns true if the layer in question is a 3rd party layer.

name: isRestrictedLicence
description: Returns true if a free licence is in use.

name: isShape
description: Checks if a specified layer is a Shape.

name: isTransform
description: Returns true if a specified layer has transform Attributes (e.g. Position and Scale).

name: has3dTransforms
description: Returns true if a specified layer has it's 3d transform Attributes activated.

name: uuid
description: Returns a UUIDv4 string.

name: getAttrType
description: Retrieves the type of a specified Attribute in a layer.

name: reorderArrayAttr
description: Reorders an Array attribute from a given index, to a given index.

name: isAttrDefault
description: Returns true if an attribute value matches its default value.

name: getAttrParent
description: Retrieves the parent attribute of a specified attribute in a layer.

name: getAttrChildren
description: Retrieves the child attributes of a specified attribute in a layer.

name: resetAttribute
description: Resets a specified attribute in a layer to its default value.

name: resetLayerAttributes
description: Resets all attributes of a specified layer to their default values, optionally ignoring transform Attributes.

name: addArrayIndex
description: Adds an index to an array attribute in a specified layer.

name: getArrayCount
description: Retrieves the count of indices in an array attribute.

name: removeArrayIndex
description: Removes an index from an array attribute in the specified layer.

name: addDynamic
description: Adds a dynamic attribute to a specified layer.

name: getSelectionBoundingBox
description: Retrieves the bounding box of the current selection (and child layers of the selection) in world space.

name: getBoundingBox
description: Retrieves the bounding box of a specified Shape and its children in local or world space.

name: getPivotPosition
description: Returns the position of a specified Layer's pivot in local or world space.

name: getRenderQueueItems
description: Retrieves the items in the render queue.

name: addRenderQueueItem
description: Adds a Composition to the render queue.

name: connectDynamicIndex
description: Connects the Dynamic Rendering index to a specified attribute in a node.

name: getDynamicIndex
description: Retrieves the current value of the Dynamic Rendering index.

name: setDynamicIndexOffset
description: Set the Dynamic Rendering Index Offset.

name: deleteLayer
description: Deletes a specified layer.

name: renameAttribute
description: Renames a specified attribute in a layer.

name: getCustomAttributeName
description: Retrieves the custom name of a specified attribute in a layer.

name: hasCustomAttributeName
description: Returns true if the specified attribute has a custom name.

name: graphPreset
description: Applies a graph preset to a specified attribute in a layer.

name: flipGraph
description: Flips the graph of a specified attribute in a layer, the flipType can be "horizontal" or "vertical".

name: createTimeMarker
description: Creates a time marker at a specified time.

name: removeTimeMarker
description: Removes a specified time marker.

name: getTimeMarkers
description: Retrieves all time marker IDs.

name: getNthBeat
description: Retrieves the time of the nth beat based on the current Composition BPM settings.

name: getProjectPath
description: Retrieves the path of the current project.

name: getAssetPath
description: Retrieves the path of the assets directory in the current project.

name: getPalettesPath
description: Retrieves the path of the palettes directory in the current project.

name: getRenderPath
description: Retrieves the path of the renders directory in the current project.

name: getScenesPath
description: Retrieves the path of the scenes directory in the current project.

name: getSceneFilePath
description: Retrieves the file path of the current Scene. Returns an empty string if the scene is unsaved.

name: getPreferencesPath
description: Provides the path to the preferences directory.

name: getPresetsPath
description: Provides the path to the presets directory.

name: getAppAssetsPath
description: Returns the path to the application's assets directory.

name: getFileModifiedDate
description: Gets the last modified time of the file in milliseconds since epoch.

name: getFileSize
description: Gets the file size in kilobytes (KB).

name: isDirectory
description: Returns true if the path exists and is a directory.

name: listDirectoryPaths
description: Returns all visible file paths in a directory, optionally including subdirectories.

name: isFile
description: Returns true if the path exists and is a regular file.

name: getAbsolutePath
description: Returns an absolute, canonical path string (resolving relative paths ../../).

name: getRelativePath
description: Computes the relative path from one location to another.

name: listDirectory
description: Returns an array of all file and folder paths directly under the given directory.

name: listDirectoryRecursive
description: Returns an array of all file and folder paths under the given directory (recursive).

name: filePathExists
description: Checks if the provided file path exists.

name: unzip
description: Unzips a zip file to a given location, returning a list of extracted top level files.

name: getFileNameFromPath
description: Extracts the file name from a given file path, with an option to include the file extension.

name: getExtensionFromPath
description: Retrieves the file extension from a given file path.

name: getFolderFromPath
description: Extracts the folder path from a given file path.

name: deleteFilePath
description: Deletes the file at the specified path.

name: copyFilePath
description: Copy a file from one specified path to another. Creates the destination location if needed.

name: makeFolder
description: Creates a new folder at the specified path, with an option to overwrite if it already exists.

name: getPlatform
description: Returns the name of the operating system platform (e.g. "macOS" or "Windows").

name: layerExists
description: Checks if a layer with the specified ID exists.

name: setAttributeExpression
description: Sets an expression for a specified attribute of a layer.

name: hasAttributeExpression
description: Returns true if the given attribute has an expression.

name: getAttributeExpression
description: Returns an Attribute's expression.

name: setAttributeDefinitionOverride
description: Set a definition override for an attribute (keys: "hardMin", "hardMax", "softMin", "softMax", "step")

name: getAttributeDefinitionOverride
description: Get a definition override for an attribute

name: clearAttributeDefinitionOverrides
description: Clear all definition overrides for an attribute

name: hasAttributeDefinitionOverrides
description: Check if an attribute has any definition overrides

name: getEffectiveAttributeDefinition
description: Get the attribute definition including any overrides

name: isGuiSession
description: Determines if the current session is a GUI session.

name: openScene
description: Opens a scene from a specified file path, with an option to force open (lose unsaved changes).

name: importScene
description: Imports a Scene from a specified file path.

name: saveSceneAs
description: Saves the current Scene to a specified file path.

name: exportSceneAs
description: Export the current Scene to a specified file path.

name: exportSelected
description: Export any selected (and connected) Layers to a specified file path.

name: duplicate
description: Duplicates a layer with the specified ID, with an option to also duplicate it's input connected layers.

name: centrePivot
description: Centers the pivot of a layer, with an option to use the centroid for centering.

name: makeFirstPoint
description: Sets the first point of an editable shape layer, based on the current point selection.

name: freezeTransform
description: Freezes the transform properties of a specified layer.

name: resetTransform
description: Resets the transform properties of a specified layer to their default values.

name: getLayerFromUUID
description: Retrieves the layer ID associated with a specified UUID.

name: getAllSceneLayers
description: Returns a list of all layer IDs in the current scene.

name: getAllLayerTypes
description: Provides a list of all layer types used in the current scene.

name: setUserData
description: Sets a user data value for a specified key on a specified layer.

name: hasUserDataKey
description: Checks if a specified key exists in the user data of a specified layer.

name: getUserDataKey
description: Retrieves the value of a specified key from the user data of a specified layer.

name: getPreference
description: Retrieves the preference value for a specified key.

name: setPreference
description: Sets a preference value for a specified key.

name: setPreferenceObject
description: Sets a preference value for a specified key.

name: hasPreferenceObject
description: Checks if a preference key exists.

name: getPreferenceObject
description: Retrieves the preference value for a specified key.

name: addToControlCentre
description: Adds a specified attribute of a specified layer to the Control Centre.

name: removeFromControlCentre
description: Removes a specified attribute of a specified layer from the Control Centre.

name: makeEditable
description: Makes a layer editable, with an option to create a copy of the layer.

name: movePoint
description: Moves selected points in an Editable Shape by a specified amount in x and y directions, with an option to use local space coordinates.

name: setPointPosition
description: Sets the positions selected points in an Editable Shape, with options for local space coordinates and including handle positions.

name: getEditablePath
description: Retrieves the editable path of a specified layer, with an option to return point coordinates in world space.

name: setEditablePath
description: Sets the editable path of a specified layer using a given path object, with an option to interpret coordinates in world space
